images.description: Dark-theme admin dashboard on a true-black canvas: a live Adelaide map with GPS-pinned workers across five sites, a KPI strip reading on-site now, unfilled today, certs expiring and awaiting review, plus a needs-attention feed and activity log.
images.altText: Dark admin dashboard with live worker map and KPI strip

images.description: Day-view roster on black: five client sites laid across a 24-hour time axis with proportional shift bars, a left panel of draggable workers carrying Compliant, Expiring and Expired certification badges, and a coverage ribbon running along the top.
images.altText: Dark day-view roster with compliance-badged workers on a time grid

images.description: Week roster in dark theme spanning Monday to Saturday across all client sites, each day column packed with per-site shift bars including overnight 10pm-6am wraps, unfilled indicators, and the coverage ribbon along the top showing daily fill rates.
images.altText: Dark week roster with shift bars across all sites

images.description: Dark-theme timesheet review with Dylan Murphy's entry flagged late: a radar-style GPS clock-in map 15 metres from site, a variance readout, a plain-language late explanation, six of six proof-of-work tasks completed, and Reject or Approve actions.
images.altText: Dark flagged timesheet with GPS map and approval controls

images.description: Worker profile drawer in dark theme showing Dylan Murphy's document wallet: SA Security Agents Licence, Working at Heights and White Card certifications on a validity timeline with expiry-countdown bars, and per-certificate status cards each marked Valid below.
images.altText: Dark worker document wallet with certification validity timelines

images.description: Dark-theme workers table listing the fourteen-person field team with phone numbers, compliance badges tallying eleven Compliant, two Expiring and one Expired, a weekly shifts bar per worker, and last clock-in time — team compliance readable at a glance.
images.altText: Dark workers list with compliance badges and weekly shifts

images.description: Job-site detail drawer in dark theme for Kingsford Corporate Tower, showing client and address fields beside an interactive map with a teal geofence circle and a radius slider set to 400 metres defining the valid GPS clock-in boundary.
images.altText: Dark job-site drawer with geofence map and radius slider

images.description: Global search command palette open over a dimmed dark dashboard, surfacing navigation grouped into Overview, Operations and Workforce sections — keyboard-accessible quick jumps to Dashboard, Roster, Timesheets, Workers or Job Sites without reaching for the sidebar.
images.altText: Dark command palette with grouped navigation sections

images.description: Tight crop of the dark day-view roster grid with sidebar and chrome removed, focusing on the coverage ribbon, five site rows, proportional shift bars and an unfilled highlight — a detail shot of the scheduling surface itself, no navigation.
images.altText: Dark roster grid closeup showing shift bars and coverage
